output.sadness: I let out a faint laugh that barely masked the hysteria creeping up inside me. "Oh, I got shampoo in my eyes, it’s nothing..." I desperately wished the aching cry in my throat would fade away into silence.
output.fear: I chuckled nervously, trying to hold back the hysteria that threatened to pour out. "Oh, I got shampoo in my eyes; it’s nothing..." I fought against the urgent cry in my throat, terrified it might escape.
output.anger: I let out a sharp laugh that barely concealed the hysteria building inside me. "Oh, I got shampoo in my eyes, it’s nothing!" I pushed the furious cry in my throat down hard, willing it to stay buried.
output.surprise: I couldn't help but let a quick laugh escape, caught off guard by the absurdity of it all. "Oh, I got shampoo in my eyes, it’s nothing!" I struggled to hold back the shocked cry bubbling in my throat.
output.disgust: I let out a brief, half-hearted laugh, disgust creeping up as the hysteria threatened to seep through. "Oh, I got shampoo in my eyes, it’s nothing to worry about..." I desperately wanted the revolting cry in my throat to vanish.
